implemented_requirements.requirement: Two vertical paddles controlled by separate keys
implemented_requirements.evidence: paddle.py defines a Paddle class with up_key and down_key handling (W/S for left, arrows for right) and update() moves the paddle within screen bounds.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball that moves and bounces off paddles and top/bottom edges
implemented_requirements.evidence: Only a single line appears in ball.py (self.serve_direction = 1). No Ball class, no update, draw, bounce logic, or collision handling is shown.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring when the ball passes a side edge
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py.check_scoring() checks ball.rect.right < 0 and ball.rect.left > SCREEN_WIDTH and calls scoreboard.increase_score().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Winning score threshold and game‑over handling
implemented_requirements.evidence: scoreboard.py defines WINNING_SCORE, has_winner(), get_winner() and game.py uses these to set game_over and display a win message.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Reset ball after each point (serve direction and delay)
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py.after_point() calls ball.reset(direction=...), and draw() shows a serve hint based on ball.serve_timer, but ball.reset and serve_timer are not defined in the provided ball.py.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Main entry point to start the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py imports Game and runs pong.run().

critical_issues: ball.py does not contain a complete Ball class; only a single attribute assignment is present.
Missing Ball methods referenced throughout the code (update, draw, reset, bounce_off_paddle, serve_timer, prev_rect, speed_x, rect).
Importing Ball in game.py will raise an ImportError or AttributeError at runtime.
Without ball movement and collision logic the core gameplay (bouncing, speed changes) cannot function.
Potential NameError for BALL_INITIAL_SPEED_X/Y etc. if Ball class were to use them, but they are not referenced in the visible code.
judge.summary: The repository provides a solid framework for the game loop, paddle control, scoring, and win handling, but the essential Ball implementation is missing. Because the Ball class and its behavior are not present, the core Pong mechanics cannot be executed, leading to a failure verdict. Functional completeness is low and the likelihood of the code running without errors is minimal.
